# v2026.11.14

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.14.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.14.md).

This release covers **4 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Invoices has Awaiting payment and Paid tabs: a paid invoice leaves Awaiting payment and shows on Paid. ([#530](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/530))
- "Prices include GST" is the lab's own setting: a Xero sync no longer changes it. ([#531](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/531))

## Changes

- Invoice tabs: Pending, Ready, Draft, Awaiting payment, Paid, No charge, Void. Approved and Sent are now Awaiting payment; its Status says Emailed when Xero sent it. A saved link to the old Sent tab opens Awaiting payment. ([#530](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/530))
- The No charge tab counts invoices and shows no total; its Date is the job's date. ([#530](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/530))
- A "GST from Xero" switch in Settings, Invoicing (on by default): each Xero sync copies every Xero item's GST onto its price item, and a draft whose GST differs from its Xero item waits. ([#531](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/531))

## Fixes

- A Xero sync no longer reads Xero's default sales tax, so it cannot switch prices to GST inside. ([#531](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/531))
- When a Xero item sets a line's GST, a different GST in the work system no longer holds the job or marks it changed. Only the work system's prices before GST are compared. ([#532](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/532))
